newsitem.title: USA: Power Efficiency in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: Power Efficiency in acquisition talks.

text.p: Power Efficiency Corp said Thursday that it is in discussions with Energy Efficiency International Inc, a foreign corporation owned by Philipp von Preysing, which has expressed an interest in making an investment in, or purchasing all or a majority of its common stock.
The company said the discussions are in preliminary stages and that there is no assurance any deal will be consummated.
Power Efficiency makes proprietary solid state electrical components which effectively reduce energy consumption in alternating current induction motors.
